summary: Describes Sequencer's Transform track (auto-added for meshes and cameras, channel toggling, quaternion interpolation, 3D trajectory display) and the property track types (Boolean, Integer, Float, Vector, Color, String, Enum, Object, UMG Margin/Widget Transform), plus overriding float/transform channels with Perlin noise.
gotchas: Disabled channels are not evaluated and ignore Auto Keying
Boolean, Integer, String, Enum and Object tracks do not interpolate
Only float/double and transform tracks support overridable (noise) channels
Noise animates around 0; use an additive section to offset it to a range

summary: Hub page linking to the UE 5.9 Preview release notes, the UE5 migration guide, and the Beta and Experimental feature lists.

Explains AVBOIT, an experimental order-independent transparency method enabled via console variables that weights translucent surfaces by depth-based transmittance in a camera-aligned voxel grid, how to prepare materials for it, its debug views, cvars and limitations.
gotchas: Experimental; needs SM6 desktop, not mobile/SM5, and turns off with MSAA
Materials that sample SceneColor or use refraction/distortion blend incorrectly (washed out)
r.AVBOIT.Support is on by default and compiles an extra shader per translucent material; set to 0 if unused
Changing r.OIT.Method at runtime recreates all render state (hitch)

summary: Covers the experimental Ambient Lighting Volume actor, a box or sphere that multiplies (darkens or tints) Movable Sky Light diffuse lighting inside it with soft edges, including runtime Set Tint, overlap rules, visualization, settings and troubleshooting.
gotchas: No effect when Lumen is the Dynamic Global Illumination Method; needs a Movable Sky Light
Desktop needs deferred renderer with Substrate; no effect with forward renderer or ray traced sky lighting
Diffuse only on opaque surfaces; reflections, translucency and fog are not tinted
Max 32 volumes per view; tint can only darken (0-1)

summary: Explains the experimental Dynamic Wind plugin that GPU-simulates bone sway and flutter for Nanite Foliage skeletal plants on Instanced Skinned Mesh components, with setup steps, wind force and push capsule components, external velocity volumes, wind data settings, Wind Mass Viewer and debug cvars.
gotchas: Experimental plugin, off by default; needs SM6 and Nanite Foliage (Experimental) enabled with restart
Bone simulation-group data can only come from PVE, USD or JSON import, not built by hand
Non-Nanite meshes need Optimize For Instancing or they are skipped
Per-mesh budget of individually simulated instances (default 256); beyond it plants use shared motion

summary: Describes the Lumen World Cache, an opt-in world-space path-traced lighting cache that replaces the Surface Cache for Lumen Hardware Ray Tracing, how to enable it, the Simplified Material ray tracing mode, visualization, cvars and limitations.
gotchas: Needs Hardware Ray Tracing (SM6; on D3D12 SM6.6 and Resource Binding Tier 3) and Full or Simplified Material mode, not Inline
Enabled only via read-only cvar in config; restart and shader recompile required
Lighting lags changes due to frame accumulation; translucent surfaces not cached
Unsupported: water, ray traced translucency, foliage and subsurface transmission, Far Field
new_in_59: The 5.9 change notes introduce the World Cache with benefits over the Surface Cache, and 5.9 shares energy-based light culling between MegaLights, Lumen hit lighting, LumenPT and the World Cache.

summary: Deep reference for Nanite mesh settings (fallback mesh, precision, trimming, Preserve Area, Max Edge Length Factor), custom fallback LODs, disk data size, Nanite visualization modes, simple/complex culling classification, ray tracing CLAS quality scaling, and debug cvars/commands like NaniteStats and streaming pool size.
gotchas: Fallback mesh is used for complex collision, lightmaps, Lumen HWRT reflections and non-Nanite platforms
Preserve Area should be enabled on foliage meshes only
r.Nanite.MaxCandidateClusters/MaxVisibleClusters cannot change at runtime (ini only); too small causes missing or blinking geometry
Too small streaming pool causes thrashing; trimming reduces disk size, not render cost

summary: Overview of the experimental Unreal Canvas agentic workspace (Unreal Canvas Bridge plugin) for generating and iterating images, video, meshes, splats and audio from editor captures and render passes, with cards, decks, graphs, Toolbox, auto-rig, importing results into the Content Browser, agent review, and how it differs from Unreal MCP.
gotchas: Experimental; Bridge enables Unreal MCP and Python dependencies and may download components/Python packages
Cutout actors are editor-only and save with the level; remove before cooking
Annotating an actor changes custom depth/stencil and removing it does not restore prior values
Cloud generation, Batch and Re-run calls are billed; generated meshes/rigs may need cleanup

summary: Explains the Unreal Stage tablet app connection screen (auto-discovery or manual IP of a remote-control-enabled editor) and choosing among multiple nDisplay Root Actors.
gotchas: Experimental
Editor must have remote control enabled to be discovered

summary: Introduces the experimental Unreal Stage tablet app for controlling nDisplay/ICVFX stages wirelessly, how to install it (iPad App Store, Android via GitHub source) and which plugins to enable.
gotchas: Experimental; tablet required, not phones
Android build requires GitHub account linked to Epic for source access
Needs an nDisplay Root Actor in the scene

summary: Lists Unreal Stage app settings: global slider sensitivity, press-and-hold lock, nDisplay Root Actor selection, application log, help, about and disconnect.
gotchas: Experimental

gotchas: Experimental
UV view requires secondary UVs on nDisplay configuration meshes

summary: Covers color grading the nDisplay cluster, per-viewport/per-node regions and ICVFX cameras from the Unreal Stage app's Color Grading tab, with its two-pane outliner and preview thumbnail.

Color Correction Regions have no placement controls in the app

gotchas: Experimental

summary: Conceptual overview of the Common UI plugin for layered, gamepad- and mouse-navigable menus: input routing to the top-painted widget tree, nodes, and activatable widgets that restore focus when overlays close, plus pointers to the quickstart and Lyra sample.

summary: Step-by-step guide to packaging the Collab Viewer (AEC/manufacturing) template to an .exe, hosting a networked design-review session, joining it by LAN scan or IP, and the in-app interaction menu and navigation modes.
gotchas: Content changes require repackaging and redistributing the .exe to all users; level content is not replicated

summary: Hub page introducing per-application guides for special considerations when importing with Datasmith from various design applications and file formats.

Reference listing every PCG graph node by category (control flow, debug, density, filter, metadata attribute ops, point ops, samplers, spatial queries, spawners, subgraph/loop) with what each does and typical uses.
gotchas: Mesh Sampler needs PCG Geometry Script Interop and Geometry Script plugins; it is costly
Load Alembic File needs the PCG External Data Interop plugin
Apply On Actor changes are not revertable by PCG
Debug and Print String do not run in non-editor/shipping builds; Get Texture Data needs a GPU for most compressed textures

summary: Explains PCG generation modes: partitioned generation (Is Partitioned, Partition Grid Size), hierarchical generation with the Grid Size node and Unbounded size, and runtime generation around generation sources with radii, scheduling policies, frustum culling and debug console commands.
keys: Treat Editor Viewport as Generation Source
gotchas: Hierarchical Generation requires partitioned PCG components
Passing data from larger to smaller grids can duplicate points; use Cull Points Outside Actor Bounds
Content made before 5.5 may need a lower Direction Weight in scheduling policy
Each generation radius should increase with grid size

summary: Hub page explaining Beta status (stable APIs, asset backward compatibility, use caution shipping) and listing Beta features such as Recovery Hub, USD, Modeling Mode, Geometry Scripting, PCG GPU processing, Substrate, Deformer Graph, UMG Viewmodel, MetaSounds, Editor Utility Widgets, Scripted Actions and Remote Control.
gotchas: Beta features may not be optimized for performance or stability or available on all platforms

summary: Hub page explaining Experimental status (no asset backward compatibility, APIs may change or be removed) and listing Experimental features such as Nanite Foliage, PCG Editor Mode and Biome, Texture Graph, Gameplay Camera System, Mover, Choosers, Modular Control Rigs, CommonUI with Enhanced Input, MetaSound Templates, and Python editor scripting.
keys: Scripting the Unreal Editor Using Python
gotchas: Epic does not recommend shipping with Experimental features; no backward compatibility guarantee

summary: UE 5.9 Preview release notes summarising new and changed features: Unreal Canvas, Python and Unreal MCP improvements and AI toolsets, Unreal Assistant, IK Retargeter operations, UAF and Control Rig updates, Lumen World Cache, AVBOIT, Nanite culling, Ambient Lighting Volumes, shadow debugging, Dynamic Wind, PCG Concave Hull, scriptable StateTrees and Blueprints, progressive navmesh, and a WebAssembly target.
gotchas: Unreal Canvas Bridge requires the Model Context Protocol plugin
Lumen World Cache requires Hardware Ray Tracing and is enabled per project
Ambient Lighting Volumes and Dynamic Wind are Experimental
Python Foundation Packages plugin was removed
new_in_59: Lists 5.9 additions: Unreal Canvas, MCP server port/origin/protocol preferences and project MCP settings, more AI toolsets, Slate Qt Bridge (PySide6), script editing of Blueprints/StateTrees/choosers, new IK Retargeter ops, Lumen World Cache, AVBOIT, Nanite culling, Ambient Lighting Volumes, Dynamic Wind; Python Foundation Packages removed.

summary: Guide to upgrading UE4 projects to UE5: Open a Copy conversion, version compatibility, mandatory changes (VS2019, no 32-bit, renamed target platform names, Chaos replacing PhysX with async physics, renamed shader debug cvars), TObjectPtr and UnrealObjectPtrTool, rendering default changes, and removed/deprecated systems (Cascade, World Composition, Matinee, Sound Cues, etc.).
gotchas: Upgraded projects cannot be opened in older engine versions; Convert in-place/Skip conversion risk data loss
Async physics runs off the Game Thread, adding input-to-physics delay
Distance field default voxel density doubled to 0.2, increasing memory
Hardware tessellation, LPV, DFGI and Blueprint Nativization removed

summary: Lists hardware (64-bit SLAT CPU, BIOS virtualization, 4 GB RAM) and OS/Docker requirements for building and running Wine-enabled Unreal Engine container images, with Docker install links.
gotchas: Windows needs 64-bit Windows 10 version 1903 or newer with Docker Desktop

summary: Walks through building a Linux container image with patched Wine plus an Installed Build of UE from the EpicGamesExt/WineResources repo, then packaging Blueprint-only projects for Win64 via RunUAT BuildCookRun inside the container.
gotchas: No C++ toolchain in the image; only Blueprint-only projects can be packaged
Requires Docker Engine 23.0.0+ and Python 3.7+

Windows long path limits can break the copy; use a short path or enable long paths

summary: Hub page for Audio Insights, the tool for profiling and debugging live audio (sources, buses, submixes, modulation) in PIE and standalone builds, linking to its subtopics and explaining how to extend it with the Audio Insights Template plugin.

NRT analysis runs in editor only, so it cannot analyze audio generated at runtime

summary: Reference for Project Settings > Audio: dialogue filename format, default sound class/concurrency/sound mix, VOIP settings, max concurrent streams, pitch clamps, master/reverb/base submixes, default audio buses, quality levels, panning and upmix methods, and debug sounds.
